# Sirach Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 17 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_017_page_001.jpg

---

**17:1** The LORD created human beings out of the earth, and he makes them return to it again.

**17:2** He gave them a limited number of days and a fixed time, and gave them authority over what is in it.

**17:3** He clothed them with strength like his own, and made them in his own image.

**17:4** He put the fear of human beings into all living things, and gave them dominion over beasts and birds.

**17:5** He gave them the use of the LORD's five gifts, and as a sixth he allotted them the mind, and as a seventh, reason — the interpreter of his gifts.

**17:6** He formed tongue and eyes for them; he gave them ears and a heart for thinking.

**17:7** He filled them with knowledge and understanding, and showed them good and evil.

**17:8** He set his eye upon their hearts to show them the greatness of his works.

**17:9** And they will praise his holy name forever, in order to tell of the grandeur of his works.

**17:10** He set knowledge before them and gave them the law of life as an inheritance.

**17:11** He established an eternal covenant with them, and revealed his decrees to them.

**17:12** Their eyes saw the glory of his majesty, and their ears heard the glory of his voice.

**17:13** And he said to them, "Beware of all injustice," and he gave each of them commands concerning their neighbor.

**17:14** Their ways are always before him; they cannot be hidden from his eyes.

**17:15** Over every nation he appointed a ruler, but Israel is the LORD's own portion.

**17:16** All their works are before him like the sun, and his eyes are continually on their ways.

**17:17** Their covenant will never be hidden from him, and their iniquities are before the LORD.

**17:18** A person's charitable giving is before the LORD like a signet ring, and he guards a person's kindness like the apple of his eye.

**17:19** Afterward he will arise and repay them, and will bring their recompense back upon their heads.

**17:20** Yet to the penitent he grants a return, and he gives comfort to those who are losing hope.

**17:21** Return to the LORD and forsake sins; pray in his presence and lessen your offenses.

**17:22** Return to the Most High and turn away from wrongdoing, and hate intensely what he hates.

**17:23** Who will praise the Most High in Hades, as those who are alive and give thanks?

**17:24** Praise ceases from the dead as if from nothing; but the one who is alive and well praises the LORD.

**17:25** How great is the mercy of the LORD, and his forgiveness to those who turn to him!

**17:26** For human beings cannot have everything, since no human being is immortal.

**17:27** What is brighter than the sun? Yet even it can be eclipsed. So flesh and blood devises evil.

**17:28** He surveys the power of the heights of heaven; while all human beings are dust and ashes.

**17:29** Great in knowledge is the LORD; he sees all things forever and watches all human ways.

**17:30** He has disclosed his works to no one in full; yet who can search out his mighty deeds?

**17:31** The assembly of the Most High will see him, and in his mighty power all things are governed.
